run_submitit_linprobe: run the MAE linear probe training job on a multi-node SLURM cluster via submitit
run_parse_args: parse command line arguments for MAE linear probe training including GPU count and node count
run_get_shared_folder: get or create the shared experiment folder under /checkpoint for the current user

run_trainer_call: execute the MAE linear probe classification training with GPU-aware distributed arguments
